items.title: James "Sing" Miller Interview, 1971-01-17
items.q: my mama called herself to send me out in the country to live, Tibidale.

ctx.x: What'd you do in cold weather?

Staying inside. Staying inside. It was cold during that time. Then when I was a boy coming up my mama called herself to send me out in the country to live, Tibidale. Chicken eats a little egg. I used to be there and catch it when they get hot and soon he dropped it I had it. Oh. Boudin man passed by. Boudin, Boudin, Boudin, Boudin, Boudin. I said, yeah, he said, what you got? I said, I got two eggs. Take them two eggs and give me a big old hunk of Boudin.
